tool.name: product_trend
tool.description: Query historical trend data of Amazon product by ASIN. Select trend dimension via type parameter: sales volume, sales amount, price, original price, main category rank, subcategory BSR rank, review count, star rating, ASIN-level monthly sales volume. Returns a flat key-value array. For AI agents to analyze product sales curves, price fluctuations, rank changes and review accumulation rhythm.

type.description: Trend dimension, default SalesVolume. Enum: SalesVolume=Monthly sales volume trend; SalesAmount=Monthly sales amount trend; Price=Price trend; ListPrice=Original list price trend; Rank=Main category monthly rank trend; BsrRank=Subcategory BSR daily rank trend; ReviewCount=Review count trend; Star=Star rating trend; AsinSalesVolume=ASIN-level monthly sales volume (only current asin itself, separate child variations).
